mapper.select: SELECT t1.id, t1.order_id, t1.curtain_id, t1.structure_id, t1.material_id, t1.node_id, t1.node_name, t1.status, t1.workshop_user_id, t2.name AS workshop_user_name, t1.note, t1.image_urls, t1.create_time, t1.update_time FROM zc_order_process_record t1 LEFT JOIN zc_workshop_user t2 ON t1.workshop_user_id = t2.id AND t2.deleted = 0 WHERE t1.deleted = 0 AND t1.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY t1.create_time ASC
